validity.recommendation: Keep as recorded -- real, distinct project; not a duplicate of any sibling Yakutia-gasification row.
validity.researcher_notes: Existence: strongly corroborated. This 207 km (recorded; 209 km per lenskrayon.ru, within normal route-vs-straight-line variance) gas transmission pipeline running from the Srednebotuobinskoye Gas and Condensate Field (Mirninsky District, Sakha Republic) to the Novolenskaya TES site near Lensk is documented across 9+ independent sources spanning 2023-2026: the RF Government's own Territorial Planning Scheme (sudact.ru, Decree 816-r as amended), the Lensk/Mirninsky-district municipal public-hearing notice (2025), the Alrosa-Gas press release (2023), two peretok.ru trade-press articles (Sept 2023, Feb 2024), a TASS article (Aug 2023), the pipeline design institute's own PDF (ipigaz.ru, 2024, giving exact 207.0 km / 530mm specs), energo-news.ru (Feb 2025, Glavgosexpertiza approval), neftegaz.ru (Apr 2025, pipe-delivery status sourced to Inter RAO), lenskrayon.ru (Jun 2024, on-the-ground construction-site report naming the same 209 km pipeline), and bigpowernews.ru/TASS (May 2026, SZPK investment-protection agreement explicitly covering 'more than 200 km of gas pipeline for the station's gas supply'). No phantom-entity risk. Classification: Fuel=Gas and PipelineType=transmission both confirmed -- the ipigaz.ru design document classifies the 530x10mm pipe as 'газопровод I класса' under SP 36.13330.2012 (pressure class I, 2.5-10 MPa design pressure), which is GEM's transmission-tier classification, not a low-pressure distribution line. Duplicate-vs-roster: BRIEF.md flags four sibling Yakutia-gasification PIDs in this batch (P6710 Srednetyungskoye-Nakyn, P3896 Kysyl-Syr-Amga-Ayan, P2706 Yakutsk-Aldan, P7600) as the 'common document set' to check against. None of the sources opened for P6682 name or describe any of those four lines, their fields, or their route corridors -- this pipeline's field (Srednebotuobinskoye) and terminus (Novolenskaya TES/Lensk) are geographically and administratively distinct from all four (which serve the central Yakutia gasification programme around Yakutsk/Nakyn/Amga/Aldan, ~500+ km to the northeast). No overlap or redundancy found; no cross_row_lead needed on this axis.

validity.recommendation: Change Owner1 from 'Alrosa-Gas JSC' (100%) to 'Novolenskaya TES LLC' (OOO "Novolenskaya TES"), with a note that Novolenskaya TES LLC is itself 99.9%-owned by AO 'Inter RAO - Elektrogeneratsiya' (a PAO Inter RAO subsidiary) per EGRUL data reported in peretok.ru. Alrosa-Gas's documented role is building/operating the UKPG (gas treatment unit) AT the Srednebotuobinskoye field and the short local distribution line to it (per ipigaz.ru and alrosa.ru) -- a related but DIFFERENT asset from the >200 km trunk transmission pipeline (МГП) that carries gas onward to the Novolenskaya TES site, which multiple independent sources consistently attribute to the TES project sponsor, not Alrosa-Gas.
validity.researcher_notes: The recorded Owner1='Alrosa-Gas JSC' (100%) appears to conflate two distinct, adjacent assets. Alrosa-Gas (a joint venture/subsidiary tied to diamond miner Alrosa) is well-documented as the builder/owner of the gas-treatment facility (UKPG, установка комплексной подготовки газа) at the Srednebotuobinskoye field itself (alrosa.ru press release, 2023-09; peretok.ru/26813, 2023-09-06) and of local/short gas-distribution infrastructure per the ipigaz.ru design PDF (which separately lists a much shorter 1.37 km, 530x9mm 'gas distribution network' pipe alongside the 207 km, 530x10mm main line). But the 207-209 km TRUNK pipeline to Novolenskaya TES is repeatedly and consistently described, across 5 independent sources spanning 2024-2026, as part of the Novolenskaya TES project's own scope, funded/built by the TES developer -- NOT by Alrosa-Gas: (1) peretok.ru/27372 (2024-02-26, Wayback-verified): reports EGRUL ownership data for OOO 'Novolenskaya TES' showing AO 'Inter RAO - Elektrogeneratsiya' holding 99.9% of the entity that the article frames as responsible for the station AND its associated ~200 km gas-supply pipeline (the article explicitly separates 'технологическое присоединение к газовой инфраструктуре Алроса-Газ' [connection TO Alrosa-Gas's infrastructure] from the trunk-pipeline construction, i.e. Alrosa-Gas is the thing being CONNECTED TO, not the builder of the connecting trunk line). (2) lenskrayon.ru (2024-06-17, url_verifier ok:true, name_found:true): a Lensk-district on-site report quoting the Novolenskaya TES site director (Денис Покровский) describing active land clearing and pipe-product delivery 'на площадке строительства магистрального газопровода' as part of the TES construction project run by 'группой компаний «Интер РАО» по заданию Правительства РФ' (the Inter RAO group of companies, on assignment from the RF Government). (3) neftegaz.ru/886763 (2025-04-17, sourced to Inter RAO, url_verifier ok:true, name_found:true): explicitly separates Alrosa-Gas's UKPG-building role from the connecting МГП (trunk gas pipeline, >200 km), states most of the required pipe product has been delivered, and sources the project's completion-date guidance (2028 per Inter RAO's own site) to Inter RAO directly. (4) 1prime.ru (2026-08-06, RIA/PRIME wire, url_verifier ok:true, name_found:true): reports a 31%% cost increase to 337.7bn RUB for the Novolenskaya TES project, itemizing 'технологическое подключение... к газовой инфраструктуре Среднеботуобинского месторождения компании «Алроса-Газ», а также строительство магистрального газопровода' as TWO SEPARATE cost/scope line items within Inter RAO's own project budget -- i.e. Inter RAO/Novolenskaya TES LLC is paying for and building the trunk pipeline as its own asset, distinct from (though connecting to) Alrosa-Gas's field infrastructure. (5) bigpowernews.ru/TASS (2026-05-12, url_verifier ok:true, name_found:true): reports the SZPK (capital-investment-protection agreement) signed by 'ООО «НоволенскаяТЭС» (дочерняя компания ПАО «Интер РАО»)' [OOO Novolenskaya TES, a subsidiary of PAO Inter RAO] explicitly covers, as part of the protected investment scope, 'для газоснабжения станции строится более 200 км газопровода' (more than 200 km of gas pipeline being built for the station's gas supply) -- i.e. the entity signing federal investment protection FOR the trunk pipeline is Novolenskaya TES LLC/Inter RAO, not Alrosa-Gas. Given five independent, dated sources (2024-2026) all consistently drawing this same builder/owner line between the UKPG+local distribution (Alrosa-Gas) and the trunk transmission pipeline (Novolenskaya TES LLC/Inter RAO), this is a high-tier, well-corroborated attribution concern, not a single-source guess. Recommend Owner1 -> 'Novolenskaya TES LLC', with a ResearcherNotes flag that its own majority shareholder (99.9%%, per EGRUL via peretok.ru) is AO 'Inter RAO - Elektrogeneratsiya'.

status_reviews.researcher_notes:
Annual-update-mode review: searched specifically for evidence dated newer than the sheet's LastUpdated=2025-08-21. Found genuinely new evidence: bigpowernews.ru/TASS (2026-05-12) and 1prime.ru (2026-08-06), both well after LastUpdated and both confirming the project -- including the trunk gas pipeline specifically -- is actively progressing, not stalled, shelved, or completed/operating. Neither source states or implies the pipeline has entered service; both describe it as still 'строится' (under construction / being built) as of mid-2026. 

The current recorded Status='proposed' appears STALE, not because the project has stopped progressing, but because it has progressed PAST 'proposed' into active physical construction, and the sheet was not updated to reflect that transition. The evidence trail for a status change to 'construction' is unusually well-dated and continuous: (1) 2024-06-17 (lenskrayon.ru): on-the-ground report of land clearing and pipe-product delivery specifically at the trunk-pipeline construction site, quoting the TES site director; (2) 2025-02-20 (energo-news.ru): Glavgosexpertiza (state expert review board) approved the TES construction design -- the formal gate that, per neftegaz.ru's own account, precedes the 'active construction phase'; (3) 2025-04-17 (neftegaz.ru, sourced to Inter RAO): pipe-product delivery for the >200km line reported substantially complete; (4) 2025-04 (Lensk municipal notice, per worklist current_ref): public hearings on the pipeline's environmental/route documentation, consistent with the tail end of pre-construction permitting rather than an untouched 'proposed' project; (5) 2026-05-12 (bigpowernews.ru/TASS): federal SZPK investment-protection agreement explicitly describes the >200km pipeline as 'строится' (under construction, present tense); (6) 2026-08-06 (1prime.ru): most recent evidence, still describing 'строительство магистрального газопровода' as an ongoing, actively-funded project component, with Inter RAO reaffirming no change to the target completion timeline. 

This is a continuous, multi-source, 2024-through-2026 evidence chain for active pipeline construction, not a single ambiguous snapshot. No source anywhere in this research pass (including the original 7-item wiki_citations.json harvest) states or implies the pipeline is complete, operating, delayed, shelved, or cancelled -- the only open question is WHEN construction began (see the Construction [ref] fill's tier=medium caveat: 2024-06 is the earliest CONFIRMED-BY date, not necessarily the true start date), not WHETHER it is underway. Recommend verdict=change, proposed_status='construction', with ConstructionYear/Month=2024/6 as a floor estimate. This does not affect the 2028 Start-year finding (validity[] spec caveat) -- a project can be under construction toward a still-current 2028 target.

summary: P6682 (Srednebotuobinskoye-Novolenskaya CHP Gas Pipeline) is a real, correctly classified (Gas, transmission), non-duplicate 207 km / 530mm trunk pipeline feeding the Inter RAO-sponsored Novolenskaya TES near Lensk, strongly corroborated across 9+ independent Russian-language sources spanning 2023-2026 (RF government planning decree, municipal hearing notice, design-institute PDF, TASS, two peretok.ru articles, neftegaz.ru, lenskrayon.ru, 1prime.ru, bigpowernews.ru/TASS). ONE significant ATTRIBUTION CONCERN staged: the recorded Owner1='Alrosa-Gas JSC' (100%) appears to conflate Alrosa-Gas's real but narrower role (building the UKPG gas-treatment facility and local distribution infrastructure AT the source field) with ownership of the actual 207 km TRUNK transmission pipeline, which 5 independent 2024-2026 sources instead consistently attribute to 'Novolenskaya TES LLC' (99.9%-owned by AO 'Inter RAO - Elektrogeneratsiya' per EGRUL data) -- recommended Owner1 change, high tier. A genuine, sourced 2028-vs-2029 completion-date discrepancy (Inter RAO's own 2028 target vs. an RF Government 2029 statement) is documented as a spec caveat but NOT recommended for a value change, since 2028 remains the more recent, sponsor-direct, repeatedly-reaffirmed figure (last reaffirmed 2026-08-06). MAJOR STATUS-REVIEW FINDING: newer-than-LastUpdated evidence (bigpowernews.ru 2026-05-12; 1prime.ru 2026-08-06) plus a continuous 2024-2025 evidence chain (lenskrayon.ru on-site report, Glavgosexpertiza design approval, neftegaz.ru pipe-delivery status) together indicate the pipeline has been under ACTIVE PHYSICAL CONSTRUCTION since at least mid-2024 -- recommending Status change from 'proposed' to 'construction' (verdict=change), with a floor-estimate Construction fill of 2024-06. All 15 worklist units carry a fills[] record: 11 REVERIFIED/REFS_ADDED with strong sourcing, and 3 left UNRESOLVED (SegmentCost -- only bundled TES-wide totals found, no pipeline-specific figure; Operator -- no explicit operator designation found pre-commissioning; and Pressure was filled, not left unresolved, at medium tier/single-source from the design PDF, 4.7 MPa working pressure, matched to the exact 207.0 km figure in the same sentence). No cross-row leads to route -- confirmed this pipeline is distinct from all four sibling Yakutia-gasification PIDs named in BRIEF.md, with no overlap found.
